CustomField.description: Situacao dos documentos do veiculo (CRLV e seguro).
CustomField.label: Situacao Documental
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(LT_CRLV_Expiration__c)), LT_CRLV_Expiration__c < TODAY()), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(LT_Insurance_Expiration__c)), LT_Insurance_Expiration__c < TODAY())), "Documentacao Vencida", IF(OR(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(LT_CRLV_Expiration__c)), LT_CRLV_Expiration__c <= TODAY() + 30), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(LT_Insurance_Expiration__c)), LT_Insurance_Expiration__c <= TODAY() + 30)), "A Regularizar (30 dias)", "Regular"))
